topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the core themes of cancer evolution and the microenvironment along with the learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Genetic Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Plasticity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer initiation and progression are driven by Darwinian clonal selection alongside alterations in the epigenetic and transcriptional landscape.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how normal tissue hierarchies and stemness characteristics dictate which cell types undergo malignant transformation.

topics.label: The Tumor Microenvironment, Inflammation, and Stromal Dependency
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate that cancer outgrowth requires supportive microenvironmental stimuli, inflammatory promoters, and stromal interactions.

topics.label: Technologies for Investigating Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic surveys experimental and computational tools, such as single-cell sequencing and spatial omics, used to map tumor heterogeneity and cell-microenvironment interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial Framework for Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic alterations, cell of origin, epigenetic states, and microenvironmental conditions converge during cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session and previews the topic for the next lecture.
